damage_function.title: Damage versus function (ChatGPT's distinction, kept as the rule)
damage_function.source: An organ can work badly today without lasting harm (a hangover's liver, a dehydrated kidney, a concussed brain), and chronic damage lowers the ceiling for good (cirrhosis, a scarred heart, lost nephrons). Two numbers per organ and tissue: function (today, 0 to 1) and damage (lasting, 0 to 1), with function never above (1 - damage).
rows: function_today = min(1 - damage, f(inputs today)); damage only rises, except by slow repair where the tissue regenerates (liver yes, heart muscle no, nerves barely, kidney nephrons no)
the drinker's liver works at 0.6 the morning after and 1.0 by evening until the damage sets the ceiling at 0.5
each organ's function today is the minimum of its input adequacies (perfusion, oxygen, fuel, electrolytes in range, temperature, toxins under threshold) x its own health
a kidney at full health with perfusion at 0.4 works at 0.4

damage += insult x (1 - resistance), where insults are sustained low function (ischaemia: function under 0.3 for over an hour damages the heart, brain and kidneys), toxins over threshold for days (alcohol, lead, mercury), infection, trauma
a shock that lasts hours leaves kidney damage even after the volume is back
damage -= repair rate while the insult is absent and NUTRITION's protein and energy allow: liver 0.01 a day, skin and gut lining 0.05, bone 0.005, heart and nerves 0, kidney 0.001
months without rum give the liver some ceiling back; a scarred heart never

a condition is a pattern of function and damage (heart failure: heart function under 0.5 for days; cirrhosis: liver damage over 0.5); MEDICINE.md keeps the names, the courses and the treatments; ANATOMY and CIRCULATION keep the numbers
the dropsy is the name for the pattern, not a separate rule
BODY.md reads organ function through CIRCULATION's deliveries (oxygen, fuel) and the brain's and senses' function; never an organ penalty of its own
one pathway per impairment, as before

species.title: The species profile: what changes for a horse, a dog, a fish-person (the reusable engine)
species.source: ChatGPT's point (outside AI), kept: the mechanisms (circulation, respiration, metabolism, repair, signalling) are shared; the anatomy and its parameters vary by species. The profile is a data record, not code. Rex's states of being (BODY.md 6) are species profiles of this kind; the merfolk's form and the fish-person's gills are rows here when the story keeper writes them.
